name: Fractured Persona
source:
Take control of Jenny's week as she goes from one stressful situation to another. Or be chill and stick with your best friend. Either way you'll meet people and get to see what kinds of things cause her problems.

[From [url=https://murray6.itch.io/fractured-persona]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
掌控珍妮一周的生活，陪她应对接踵而至的压力。或者轻松一点，只与最好的朋友待在一起。无论如何，你都会遇见不同的人，并了解究竟是什么给她带来了困扰。

[摘自[url=https://murray6.itch.io/fractured-persona]itch.io[/url]]
